def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    vans = image_patch.find("van")
    roundabouts = image_patch.find("roundabout")
    roads = image_patch.find("road")

    if not vans or not roundabouts or not roads:
        return []

    # Find the van closest to the roundabout
    van_closest_to_roundabout = min(vans, key=lambda v: distance(v, roundabouts[0]))

    # Filter vans that are near the roundabout
    near_vans = [v for v in vans if distance(v, roundabouts[0]) < 100]

    # Sort vans by their horizontal center to get those on the right side
    near_vans.sort(key=lambda v: v.horizontal_center)

    return near_vans
